source: Normalized transcription of fresh authorized Remote Desktop Commander GET results; registry supplied the named scope. Not a raw HTTP archive.
scope: 25 registered deployed automotive dealer projects, not the entire Vercel account

method.localized: Three actual design entries per dealer times en/bg, with the opposite Accept-Language; status and SSR markers only
method.legacy: Each of the 75 existing unprefixed design entries requested separately; all returned HTTP 200
method.writes: No preference POST, business submission or deployment performed by the fleet audit

limits: SSR markers are not proof of visible first-visit popup, persistence, complete catalogs or browser fit.
Legacy HTTP 200 is availability evidence only, not language correctness.
Only the exact recorded requests were checked; no wildcard fleet certification.
Registry deployment IDs were not treated as current production proof.
Al Reef broader acceptance is separate previously committed evidence.
